faq.q: What is the origin of Seyma?
faq.a: Seyma is associated with Arabic. Seyma is the Turkish form of Arabic شَيْمَاء (Shaymāʾ), associated with a birthmark or mole.
Yes — the underlying form شَيْمَا is Arabic.
Seyma can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Seyma should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Shaymāʾ is not a Quranic personal name.
